name: touch-3-s3r-gw1
description: In md1_2 after it loads, wait 30 frames, then route to gateway 1 over the walkmesh with drag directions, at most 9000 frames, driving scenes (Interact, FIELD_ACTIONS, through every message window that waits for Circle); then wait 600 frames and read the field ID (map_cur, raw). Route reports: out_g (1 reached, 2 stuck, 3 timeout, 4 left field mode, 5 no walkmesh, 6 no goal, 7 no path), path (triangles), locked, scenes, smode (first gameState other than field seen in a drive, 0 none), remain (triangles left to the goal).
